high_level_description: The image is a news article from "Prague Morning" dated July 6, 2024, titled "Blade Runner 2099 Begins Filming in Prague." The article mentions that the production will be one of the largest ever in the Czech capital, with Barrandov Studio fully booked for the sci-fi series over the next six months. The visual part of the image features a nighttime scene with a futuristic cityscape in the background. The architecture includes tall, illuminated buildings with pointed spires, reminiscent of Gothic or Baroque styles, suggesting a blend of historical and futuristic elements.
